explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 94 named tracks/releases across Juno's current techno window, Boomkat's September 14 new-release index, Resident Advisor current reviews, official label Bandcamp pages, adjacent emerging-label catalogues and targeted persistent-state cross-checks. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Jay Mitta — Sawa and Lotic — Carried remain removed after severe listener feedback; Luigi Tozzi — Tender Is The Night remains positively retained. Explicit threat- or panic-coded propositions were deprioritized.
Completed Runs 232, 233, 235, 236 and 239 were compared before ranking. None of the top three proposed boundaries repeats a boundary from those runs.

Every ranked artist/title pair was checked against canonical state, target-local discovery/rejection/PARKED history and the global utility ledger. Previously evaluated Oscar Later tracks Wenlocked, Air Time For Andre and The Moon Belongs To You; unresolved That's Quite A Lot Of Zeroes!; unresolved Eddie Richards tracks Destiny and The Soul; and previously requested PS11 tracks Stratos, Mid Point and Timble Snake were excluded.
Thaem Nue, It Never Made Sense, Mile High, Fairlight, Yaya, Something 4 U, Dreams Of An Insomniac, Morning (Ambient Mix) and Noctara are newly ranked exact-title leads, not triggered revisits.

Multiple Oscar Later leads have differentiated exact-track prose. Dea and Immortal leads remain lower-ranked because only release-level evidence is available. No artist, texture, novelty, genre or boundary-diversity quota is applied.
No proposed placement splits Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer.
